plan.registration_amendment: Initial registration is retained in initial_registration.json. Before any replay, JSON tuple/list normalization was fixed in protocol comparison; hypotheses, costs, selection, dates and gates were not changed.
plan.objective: maximize net profit after costs subject to unchanged sample/drawdown and runtime risk guards

variants.name: baseline
variants.hypothesis: M30 sweep, M1 confirmation, both directions; original exits

variants.name: spread_1_2
variants.hypothesis: Reject entries above 1.2 pips observed spread

variants.name: spread_0_9
variants.hypothesis: Reject entries above 0.9 pips observed spread

variants.name: trail_gap_0_75
variants.hypothesis: Keep 1R activation; tighten trailing gap to 0.75R

variants.name: trail_gap_0_5
variants.hypothesis: Keep 1R activation; tighten trailing gap to 0.5R

plan.fixed_selection: Per family and overall, maximize total net summed over first six TRAINING windows; positive/improved sum, >=4 windows with >=20 trades, DD sum<=1.25 baseline. Otherwise baseline. Training windows overlap and sums are diagnostics only.
plan.adaptive_selection: Per family and overall, maximize own preceding training net; >=20 trades, positive/improved net, DD<=1.25 baseline. Otherwise baseline.
plan.promotion: Fixed TRAINING-nominated alternative only: improved aggregate net, positive/improved confirmation net, >=20 confirmation trades, aggregate/confirmation DD<=1.25 baseline, positive/not-worse stressed confirmation net.
plan.test_comparison: Replay every predeclared model on every test fold and stressed confirmation; rank by net profit DESCRIPTIVELY. Never use this ranking to change frozen training nominations or promotion gates.
plan.engine_alignment: Replay defaults to the configured trade_side_filter, matching live; previously the replay default silently allowed both sides. Explicit --side remains an intentional research override. Live/replay share a finite, nonnegative spread gate with 1e-9-pip arithmetic tolerance at the boundary. All models including baseline are rerun.
plan.unchanged_risk: 0.1% risk, 20-pip initial SL, max lot 0.05, sizing/valuation fail-closed, one position per symbol, daily loss/exposure guards; no wider stops. Exit hypotheses only tighten the trailing gap; activation remains 1R.
limitations: These USDCHF dates and baseline/side results were previously examined; this is exploratory research, not untouched future validation.
A test-period winner can reflect chance and multiple comparisons. No live readiness is inferred.
Folds reset flat at EUR 10,000; returns sum without compounding. Drawdown measures realized cash flow, not intratrade equity.
Native bid OHLC and historical spreads; assumed commission/slippage, constant symbol valuation; no swaps, latency or full tick reconstruction.
Direction-only variants replay the entire signal/capacity path; they are not post-hoc deletion of losing trades.
